{{Top|leg}}
The '''Spumani Crusaders''' were a [[Spumani]] group who operated during the time of the [[New Sith Wars]]. When the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]] [[Conquest of Sarrassia|conquered]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]], he prevented the Crusaders from pursuing quests against the [[Grumani Hierophant]]s on the world.
